# 第三方组件许可信息

本项目使用了以下第三方开源组件，按照其各自的许可条款使用。

## Python 依赖许可

| 组件 | 版本 | 许可 | 许可文件 |
|------|------|------|----------|
| torch | - | BSD | https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/LICENSE |
| transformers | - | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/LICENSE |
| numpy | - | BSD | https://github.com/numpy/numpy/blob/main/LICENSE.txt |
| opencv-python | - | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/master/LICENSE |
| tensorboard | - | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorboard/blob/master/LICENSE |
| PyYAML | - | MIT | https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/master/LICENSE |
| requests | - | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/main/LICENSE |
| tqdm | - | MIT/MPL 2.0 | https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm/blob/master/LICENCE |
| matplotlib | - | BSD | https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/blob/main/LICENSE/LICENSE |
| Pillow | - | Historical | https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/main/LICENSE |
| scipy | - | BSD | https://github.com/scipy/scipy/blob/main/LICENSE.txt |
| scikit-learn | - | BSD | https://github.com/scikit-learn/scikit-learn/blob/main/COPYING |
| einops | - | MIT | https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/blob/master/LICENSE |
| timm | - | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/LICENSE |
| hydra-core | - | MIT | https://github.com/facebookresearch/hydra/blob/main/LICENSE |
| omegaconf | - | BSD | https://github.com/omry/omegaconf/blob/main/LICENSE |
| wandb | - | MIT | https://github.com/wandb/wandb/blob/main/LICENSE |
